attchmntText: K.P. Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: KP Energy Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with the BSE and NSE. The presentation details Q2 FY27 financials showing revenue from operations at 539 Crore, up 79% year-on-year from 301 Crore. EBITDA was 65 Crore, down 6% from 69 Crore. Profit after tax stood at 27 Crore, a 25% decline from 36 Crore. For the half year, revenue reached 1058 Crore, while PAT was 53 Crore. The company holds a total installed capacity of 2.09 GW and a renewable portfolio of 3.73 GW. KP Energy is identified as a balance-of-plant provider for wind and hybrid projects. The document outlines industry tailwinds, including India's wind energy opportunity and policy support. It also describes the company's end-to-end execution model, grid connectivity, and in-house resource assessment capabilities. The presentation includes board details and group structure information.

attchmntText: K.P. Energy Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: K.P. Energy Limited announced the approval of its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 531.76 lakhs rupees. Revenue from operations stood at 105814.38 lakhs rupees. The statutory auditors, MSKC and Associates LLP, conducted a limited review and issued an unmodified conclusion. The company also allotted 2,02,258 equity shares upon exercise of options under the Employee Stock Option Schemes Plan 2023. Adjusted basic earnings per share for the half year was 0.53 rupees.
